channel.title: HPCC Service Status
channel.description: We'll post information about ICER's system downtimes, updates, new features, and other information for the ICER user community here.

item.title: Home Filesystem Currently Offline - RESOLVED
item.description:
RESOLVED: 3:45PM The home file system has been restored and the scheduler has been resumed.

The VAST home filesystem is currently offline. The scheduler is currently paused while we address this issue. OnDemand web sessions may be inaccessible as well. We are currently working with our software vendor to bring the home filesystem back online.

item.title: Home Filesystem SMB Currently Offline
item.description: Due to a system issue, SMB access to the home filesystem is currently offline. We’ll update this blog post when SMB access is available.

item.title: MSU Network Errors
item.description:
UPDATE: 4:30pm 9/21/2026
The cluster is up and healthy. Some hardware from the outage will require more attention but most everything is up.
Please contact us if you notice anything wrong.

UPDATE: 3:20pm 9/21/2026
The amd24 cluster is available now

UPDATE: 3:00pm 9/21/2026
The amd20 cluster is available now

UPDATE: 1:30pm 9/21/2026
The intel18 cluster is available now

UPDATE: 11:30am 9/21/2026
Gateways, OpenOnDemand, and Globus access are enabled. Dev nodes are up. Usage should be back to normal on those. Continuing with the remaining cluster nodes.

UPDATE: 10:00am 9/21/2026
MSU Power is now stable and ICER can begin the process of returning to normal. We are currently in maintenance mode to test critical functions. User access is blocked during testing. Once we confirm internal stability, we will return the cluster back to production in sections starting with dev nodes. We will provide updates as this happens.

UPDATE: 10:30am 9/20/2026
As many of you know, the university experienced a widespread power outage that began last night. While power has largely been restored, there are significant ongoing challenges and ICER’s computing systems have been shut down in order to reduce power consumption and to avoid damaging equipment. We will resume normal operations as soon as possible; however, it is likely that this will not be until at least tomorrow (Monday, 9/21).

ICER is experiencing random errors due to a larger MSU Network Issue. We will continue monitoring the situation when the campus wired network is stable again.

item.title: Home Filesystem Maintenance Friday 09/18/26 - UPDATED 9/23/26
item.description:
UPDATE - 9/23/26 - Some of the home filesystem maintenance was postponed and is scheduled to be completed the week of 9/28/26. This blog will be updated when the maintenance is complete.

On Friday, September 18th, a minor configuration change will be applied to the home file system. No outage or performance impacts are anticipated. This blog will be updated once the configuration change is complete.

item.title: Scavenger Queue Paused - RESOLVED
item.description:
RESOLVED: 9/22: The scavenger queue is back online. We identified the job requests that trigger the preemption issue and implemented scheduler logic to account for them.

UPDATE: 9/18: We are working with our software vendor to resolve this issue.

We have temporarily paused running jobs through the scavenger queue while we investigate a potential issue with job preemption. If you have any questions, please contact us.

item.title: Nodes down - RESOLVED 8/26
item.description:
RESOLVED - All nodes affected during maintenance are back into service. Some nodes in the HPCC are still offline, but this is due to typical hardware issues and is in line with usual compute node availability.

After yesterday’s maintenance, some compute nodes are not available for job scheduling. This is primarily affecting nodes with GPUs. Jobs requesting GPUs will likely queue for longer than usual or, depending on constraints, will stay in the queue until nodes are returned to service.

Our system administrators are working on this and will return nodes to service as soon as possible. Updates will be posted here.

item.title: Globus Down
item.description:
2026-08-20 4:45pm - Issue with Globus has been resolved and back online.

Globus experienced problems during summer maintenance today and is currently offline. We will continue to work on it.

item.title: Research Space Storage Outage
item.description: The file system manager for research spaces on the HPCC has failed and is being recovered. Jobs that were reading or writing to research spaces at the time may have failed. Please contact us if you notice any issues.

item.title: Research Filesystem Maintenance
item.description:
layout: post title: “Research Filesystem Maintenance Wednesday 08/12/26 to Thursday 8/20/26 - RESOLVED” date: 2026-08-12 08:00:00 -0300 categories: maintenance tags: resolved —

RESOLVED - 08/27/2026 - The Research Filesystem maintenance has been completed successfully.

Beginning Wednesday, August 12th, we will be updating the research file system. No outage is anticipated; however, you may notice periodic slowdowns as components of the file system are rebalanced and rebooted. This work is scheduled to be completed during our summer maintenance window on Thursday, August 20, and this blog will be updated once the upgrade is complete.

item.title: Home Filesystem Maintenance Friday 08/14/26 - RESOLVED
item.description:
RESOLVED: 8/14/2026 - The home file system has been successfully upgraded.

On Friday, August 14th, at 7AM, an update will be applied to the home file system. No outage or performance impacts are anticipated. This blog will be updated once the upgrade is complete.
